subject: planner: fix the possble wrong plan for dp join reorder (#63648)
summary: Reviewed `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder_dp.go`: the fix correctly prevents DP join-reorder from reusing stale `nodeID2VisitID` mappings across BFS components (by resetting to `-1` and skipping eq-edges whose endpoints aren’t in the current subgraph), which otherwise can incorrectly treat disconnected join components as connected and build invalid/incorrect join predicates. Added regression coverage (`TestIssue63353`) asserts a disconnected equality-graph produces a CARTESIAN join between the components. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/session/txn behavior within planner scope, and later history only refactors/removes tracing without changing this logic.
